targets.browser_support: Chrome or Edge with Web Serial
targets.summary: Full Hopspot build: Wi-Fi Auto, BLE Auto, LoRa, ESP-NOW, USB Auto.
steps: Connect a USB-C data cable to your Heltec and plug it into this device.
Click 'Connect and flash' below.
Choose the port labeled USB JTAG/serial debug from the browser prompt.
If your device is not detected, hold BOOT, tap RESET, then release BOOT.
Wait for flash verification, then reset once.

targets.summary: nRF52840 UF2 Hopspot build: BLE Auto, LoRa, USB Auto.
steps: Connect a USB-C data cable to your T-Echo and plug it into this device.
Double-tap RESET so the TECHOBOOT drive mounts.
Click 'Download UF2' below.
Copy the downloaded UF2 file to TECHOBOOT.
The T-Echo reboots into the new firmware after the copy completes.
